lead.t: Temporary CSF diversion: an external ventricular drain (EVD) or ventricular reservoir (Ommaya) for intraventricular haemorrhage and ventriculitis, until the CSF is clear of blood and infection (high protein would block a shunt valve).
lead.s: Hydrocephalus: Causes, Presentation and CSF Diversion (Shunts)
